audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[].side read 'Katarina' while content win[] read Brand on all seven, the packet levelChart is Brand x7, and every phases[].why and whys[] sentence describes Brand winning that stage. The row and the sentence under it said opposite things on every single row.
audit.why: Three sources agree on Brand (packet chart, content win[], and the prose in both layers), and the matchup sits at 50.89% over 621 games — not a lane Katarina owns from level 1.
audit.corrected: phases[0..6].side = Brand, matching win[] and the packet; whys already read as Brand winning, with the two misgendered ones repaired.

audit.why: Brand spikes at 3 (E-Q package), 6 (Pyroclasm, 100s) and Liandry's. Katarina's spike is level 6 Death Lotus at 75s and then any kill, because Voracity slashes her remaining cooldowns on a champion death near her.
audit.corrected: enemyWin rewritten around Voracity resets and the Death Lotus channel rather than 'landing Shunpo'.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Death Lotus is a channel and Brand's Sear stun cancels it outright. Two fields also credited Pillar of Flame with a stun — Pillar has no CC; Sear stuns, and only against an already-ablaze target.
audit.why: Riot's text: Death Lotus is a channel; Sear stuns if the target is ablaze; Pillar of Flame only damages and adds 25% to ablaze targets.
audit.corrected: Put the Sear-cancels-Death-Lotus line in winCon and breakdown.cooldowns, and corrected the two Pillar-stun claims to Conflagration-then-Sear.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit and pointed only at Shunpo generically.
audit.corrected: Rewrote with both numbers and the window each one opens.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] told you to punish Katarina's 'mana-hungry poke phase'. Katarina has no mana — Q, W, E and R all cost 0.
audit.why: Every ability in the kit file lists cost 0. Advice built on starving her resource is unfollowable.
audit.corrected: Replaced with punishing her free-cast dagger poke.

edits.before: Stun-burn the dive, tax the roams with shove, and out-scale his patience. Nothing here works through Shunpo — schedule your pattern around its cooldown.
edits.after: Bank Sear for her Death Lotus — any stun cancels the channel outright. Shunpo is 12s at rank 1, so step up only in the window right after she blinks.

edits.after: Katarina wins by chaining Shunpo off her own daggers, resetting on a kill through Voracity, and channeling Death Lotus uninterrupted.

edits.before: - Katarina Shunpo: matchup-defining — Her blink to daggers and targets — hard CC during her resets and she folds. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E-Q stun package for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Shunpo: 12s at rank 1 falling to 8s — she gets one blink per trade, so the window right after she spends it is yours. - Death Lotus is a channel: your Sear stun cancels it outright, so bank Q whenever her 75s ultimate is available.
